source_text: Obfirma faciem tuam contra filias populi prophetantes de corde suo. Est alia facies praeter corporis — facies animae quae adversus mendacium firmatur.
pass_a_gloss: Set your face against the daughters of the people prophesying from their own heart. There is another face besides the body’s — the soul’s face which is firmed against the lie.
pass_b_english: [[Set your face against the daughters of your people who prophesy from their own hearts >> Bible:Ezekiel 13:17]]. The soul has a face that must be braced against lying oracles.
notes: True OET; no Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel.
anf_compare: no ANF for Jerome Ezekiel homilies; do not copy Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel
